title: The rectangle with area 40
caption: Width w and length w + 3 give area w(w + 3) = 40. The root w = 5 gives the 5 cm by 8 cm rectangle, area 40 cm²; the root w = −8 has no meaning as a length.
alt: A rectangle 5 cm wide and 8 cm long with area 40 square centimetres.
description: A rectangle has width w and length w + 3.
Its area is w(w + 3) = 40, which factorises as (w + 8)(w − 5) = 0.
Only w = 5 is a possible width, so the rectangle is 5 cm by 8 cm.
